mechanism.suite_class: A qualification-only TestSuite subclass installed as the actual TestLoader.suiteClass before loadTestsFromNames.
mechanism.nested_coverage: Walk the loaded suite tree without mutation or flattening. Require every suite directly executing a TestCase to use the tracing subclass. Preserve exact frozen IDs/order.
mechanism.official_runtime_binding: Bind and source-test the official CPython3.14.4 TestSuite.run/hook call structure; do not assume the outermost suite executes all fixtures.
mechanism.super_calls: Invoke each inherited hook exactly once with the original arguments. Do not run or call a fixture for observation.
mechanism.normal_vs_error: The setup hook may return normally after recording a fixture Exception. Read its actual _classSetupFailed/module-failure state and label this separately; finally is never proof of successful setup.
mechanism.logging_failure: Before-call or after-success write failure makes the new operation HOLD. When preserving an already raised original BaseException, a secondary logging failure must not replace it. No logging failure permits PASS.
mechanism.write: Fixed owned ordinary create-only file, bounded one JSON line per event, no arbitrary object repr, flush each line, bind complete bytes and size at final receipt. SIGKILL can leave a valid prefix, never a complete-PASS marker.
mechanism.ledger_scope: Do not rewrite existing step/test Counter attribution in this logging change. Current counters are last-startTest keyed during class fixtures; progress events expose the fixture boundary separately.
mechanism.authority: Progress is diagnostic only; the original loaded/executed116 and zero five-anomaly checks plus owner closure remain mandatory. A partial progress file proves only its recorded prefix.

required_source_controls: Nested suite coverage and exact original116 ordering without execution or reordering.
One actual fixture invocation and distinct normal/fixture-error/BaseException observations.
No false test start or successful setup event on a setup failure.
Secondary log error cannot mask original exception; successful operation requires a complete log receipt.
Fixed file/bounds/strict monotonically ordered sequence and integer timestamps; truncate or duplicate row rejected.
Old test bodies, IDs, native limits and original owner180/3 stay byte/AST equal.
